prediction: PUT THE CRITICAL PATH ON THE BIG CORE. The guest CPU thread bounds the frame (frame-pacing-and-parallelism.md: busy 41.5 of a 50.2 ms Crimson frame), yet in the 09-11 Crimson simpleperf capture (perf.data, 15,608 vCPU samples) it ran on the Cortex-X3 (cpu7) for only 15.2% of its samples, on the 2.8 GHz A715/A710 cores (cpu3-6) for 84.6%, and changed core between ~123 consecutive 1 ms samples a second. The fork's affinity code (XEMU_OPT_THREAD_AFFINITY) is compiled out. Arm B pins only the vCPU thread (the thread that generates code) to the CPUs with the highest cpuinfo_max_freq; both arms run the HAKUX_TOPO sampler at 200 ms so placement is measured on both sides, and the sampler runs on cpu0-2. MODEL: X3 at 3.19 GHz does ~1.4x the work of an A715/A710 at 2.8 GHz on this branchy, cache-heavy code (clock 1.14x times IPC ~1.25x; the HAKUX_HOSTBENCH survey at 9181cb4c13 measures the per-core ALU/load ratio on the same device). With 85% of vCPU time moved, vCPU work shrinks by ~26%; Galleon is guest-bound (renderer idle ~27 ms of a 52 ms frame in #54's arms) so most of that reaches frame time. POINT PREDICTION: game frame time -18%. P0 (did it execute): every B run logs 'place vcpu ... -> PINNED' and the vCPU tid spends >= 90% of its time on cpu7 by the sampler; every A run logs '-> NOT PINNED' and <= 50% on cpu7. P1: median game frame time changes by a value within [-35%, -5%]. A change above -5% (smaller gain, or a loss) FAILS and refutes the model: then either the X3 is not faster on this code, or the pinned core is thermally capped, and P3 and the p7 clock in the judge's table say which. Below -35% also FAILS: it would mean something other than core speed moved (migration cost larger than modelled). P2: between-arm delta exceeds within-arm spread. P3 (sustain, and the reason this is not free on a handheld): B's late-half median G is at most +10% over its early half. 240 s does not reach thermal equilibrium on a handheld; a pass here is necessary, not sufficient, and a 20-minute soak is the follow-up if P1 passes. P4: worst-run gfps p90 of B >= worst-run gfps p90 of A.
